title: Sampling-unit and join-identifiability audit of pinned HARV2020 NEON-derived bird records
contribution_type: bounded reproducible methods and data audit
predecessor_credit: NEON original observations; Li et al. (2022), Ecosphere 13:e4141, doi:10.1002/ecs2.4141, and all coauthors; Daijiang Li and Eric Sokol for bird package processing/documentation. No endorsement or participation by those authors is implied.
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in planning, source inspection, code, tests, calculation, drafting, fresh AI review and publication preparation. AI review is not human peer review.
claim: The fixed 1,163-row HARV2020 derivative contains 536/540 represented standard unit-minute strata and 34 incidental rows. Actual R key expressions preserve the documented key on synthetic schemas. Constructive source histories demonstrate that final unique derived rows do not identify original multiplicity or attempted-survey denominators.
